registration_timing: Seal features, contrast assignments, candidate and pair IDs, identity certificates, support diagnostics, registry hash, and protocol hash before outcome generation or reveal.

direction_value.estimand: Attribution-selected direction minus matched-random direction at the same site.
direction_value.site_rule: site_id must be identical within pair

site_selection.estimand: Attribution-selected site minus matched-random site while direction policy is fixed.
site_selection.direction_rule: direction_policy must be identical within pair

primary_analysis: For each contrast separately, report paired intervention-minus-matched-random effects within each identity stratum with a two-sided run-replicate-cluster sign-flip test.
support_reporting: Report pair counts, empty strata, Jacobian-visibility distance, and activation-RMS distance. Never silently discard or pool unsupported candidates.

stop_rules.caliper_failure: Pair is ineligible before sealing and must be reported as outside matched support.
stop_rules.signed_edit_below_holonomy_clean: Record as unauthorized engineering evidence; do not relabel or claim harness authorization.

clean_conclusion: Direction value and site-selection value are distinct estimands. Each is reported only against its matched-random control within the same preregistered identity stratum.
